included.description:
Activate Whisperwood Elemental by sacrificing it.
When Whisperwood Elemental dies, Yedora triggers, returning Whisperwood Elemental from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Whisperwood Elemental enters the battlefield, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whisperwood Elemental by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Whisperwood Elemental face-up.
Resolve the Whisperwood Elemental ability from step 1.
Repeat.

produces: Put all basic lands from your library onto the battlefield tapped
included.description:
Activate Sakura-Tribe Elder by sacrificing it.
When Sakura-Tribe Elder dies, Yedora triggers, returning Sakura-Tribe Elder from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Sakura-Tribe Elder enters the battlefield as a Forest land, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sakura-Tribe Elder by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Sakura-Tribe Elder face-up if its not the first time the ability has resolved this turn, or causing you to manifest dread otherwise.
Resolve the Sakura-Tribe Elder ability from step 1, allowing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Zimone triggers, turning Sakura-Tribe Elder face-up if it is still face-down.
Repeat.

Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Yavimaya Elder by paying {2} and sacrificing it.
When Yavimaya Elder dies, it and Yedora trigger.
Resolve the Yavimaya Elder trigger, allowing you to search your library for up to two basic land cards and put them into your hand.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning Yavimaya Elder from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Yavimaya Elder enters, Retreat to Coralhelm and Zimone trigger.
Holding priority, activate Yavimaya Elder by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping the mana-producing creature.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Yavimaya Elder face-up.
Resolve the Yavimaya Elder ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
included.prerequisites: ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
